info.name: Pioneer XDJ-RX
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ mapping for the XDJ-RX all-in-one in PC control (MIDI) mode: two decks, the mixer, Beat FX and Sound Color FX, hot cue, pad FX and auto loop pads. Beta: written from AlphaTheta's XDJ-RX list of MIDI messages and rekordbox's XDJ-RX mapping, not yet tried on the hardware.
